Both the base-change of ̂ T and T Q to ( ∏ p ̂ B ) Q are chosen such that the associated map from tmf Q sends c 4 and c 6 to their q -expansion maps. From the equivalences above, this shows that these oriented elliptic curves are equivalent over ( ∏ p ̂ B ) Q . The fact that ( ∏ p ̂ B ) Q has homotopy groups concentrated in even degrees also shows that the choice of equivalence is unique up to homotopy; even up to 3-homotopy. This yields the oriented elliptic curve T over B .
